_about: Decisions made by looking at the contact sheets and the zoomed crops on 2026-10-30. The codes are cell codes from IMAGE-AUDIT-CONTACT-SHEETS (brand prefix, product number, then a gallery letter when there is one). This file lists only cells where looking at the image changed or sharpened the automatic result. confidence: confirmed means the logo, brand mark, watermark or defect is clearly visible. needs-confirmation means the reviewer could not be sure from the image alone.
